name: SpectralControls.unique_projector_decomposition
statement: theorem unique_projector_decomposition {M : Type} [IntModule M] (p q : M → M) (pl : ∀ a b, p (a+b) = p a+p b) (ql : ∀ a b, q (a+b) = q a+q b) (hs : ∀ a, p a+q a = a) (hpq : ∀ a, p (q a) = 0) (hqp : ∀ a, q (p a) = 0) (x : M) : p x+q x = x ∧ p (p x) = p x ∧ q (q x) = q x ∧ ∀ a b, p a = a → q b = b → a+b = x → a = p x ∧ b = q x

name: SpectralControls.polynomial_projector_naturality
statement: theorem polynomial_projector_naturality {M N : Type} [IntModule M] [IntModule N] (pi : M → M) (tau : N → N) (f : M → N) (fl : ∀ (n : Int) a, f (n • a) = n • f a) (fa : ∀ a b, f (a+b) = f a+f b) (fc : ∀ a, f (pi a) = tau (f a)) (u a b c d : Int) (x : M) : f (u • (a • pi (pi (pi x))+b • pi (pi x)+c • pi x+d • x)) = u • (a • tau (tau (tau (f x)))+b • tau (tau (f x))+c • tau (f x)+d • f x)
